label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with _____, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verse: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
note: Joel's call to return — and the next verse says rend your heart, not your garments.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being _____ and grounded in love,
verse: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
note: Paul prays for roots: faith gives Christ a home in your heart, and love gives you somewhere to grow.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, _____; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
verse: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
note: 'Hosanna' is a Hebrew cry meaning 'save now' — the Palm Sunday crowd shouting a prayer and a welcome at once.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open _____, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
verse: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
note: To Philadelphia, with only 'a little strength': an open door no one can shut — faithfulness outranks size.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in _____ and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
verse: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
note: Joshua's farewell: serve the LORD 'in sincerity and in truth' — the next verse is his famous 'as for me and my house.'
